findings.title: code-quality job summary uses $? from echo (pre-existing, out of TP scope)
findings.body: Expert identified that the code-quality job's ADHD-friendly summary step uses $? which reflects the preceding echo's exit code, not pre-commit's. This is a pre-existing issue in the code-quality job (not ci-summary). It does not affect gate correctness: ci-summary reads needs.code-quality.result (the job's overall exit status), not $? from within the job. Spawned as separate follow-up task. Status normalized from OUT_OF_SCOPE to ACCEPTED_RISK (OUT_OF_SCOPE not in schema enum).
